verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls. The MCP server's write-disable and tool-category toggles limit what an agent can do, which is a different control, not a tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
